## Summary
<!-- 1-3 bullets. What changed, why. -->

## Type of change
- [ ] feat - new user-visible functionality
- [ ] fix - bug fix
- [ ] docs - documentation only
- [ ] refactor - no user-visible change
- [ ] perf - performance improvement
- [ ] test - tests only
- [ ] ci - infrastructure
- [ ] chore - housekeeping

## Checks
- [ ] `devtools::document()` run (NAMESPACE + `man/` up to date)
- [ ] `devtools::test()` passes (including new tests for new behaviour)
- [ ] `lintr::lint_package()` clean
- [ ] `NEWS.md` updated for any user-visible change
- [ ] `@examples` runnable for any new exported function
- [ ] Vignettes still build (`R CMD build`) if touched
- [ ] `air format .` run (or pre-commit hook installed)

## Linked issues
Closes #
